title: Monarch Reel 01 — motion test
notes: 3 shots x 77 frames (4.8 s each, Wan ka native 16 fps) + Kokoro voice + ambience bed. Motion-first prompts: rain, smoke, wind. Ab 24 fps par duplicate nahi hota.

dialogue.text: Every frame here was generated on a free graphics card.
No studio. No crew. Only a phone, and one tap.
This is Monarch Studio. Your next reel starts here.

shots.prompt: cinematic low angle tracking shot of heavy rain hammering a neon lit city street at night, water splashing off wet asphalt, a lone figure in a long black coat walking toward camera under a flickering sign, reflections rippling in puddles, camera tracking backward, strong motion, film grain, shallow depth of field, no text
shots.foley_prompt: heavy rain on wet asphalt, distant traffic, neon city night ambience
